name: Choose a Pet
steps: Drag food bowl to puppy to make it chubby.
Drag parrot to stand to make it talk.
Tap pug to make it cute and harmless.
Drag weights to dog to make strong guide dog.
Use hair dryer on puppy to make it fluffy.
Drag Mario hat to kitten to change its look.
Tap cheese to call mouse, then frog catches it.
Drag phone to customer to give digital pet.
